notes.title: Patch 1.1 with Unit and Ability Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello again on this lovely Sunday!

It has been two weeks since the full release of [i]For The Fatherland[/i] with even more soldiers joining the battle! I have received plenty of new feedback and decided to put some of it into the game.

[b]Patch 1.1 brings along:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed known animation issues such as units being stuck in the t-pose (no idea why this suddenly happened)
[*] Implemented a notification for lost units: you will now get a message should one of your units die
[*] Changed the healing and taking cover abilities to global: they now apply to all units, you don’t need to select individual units anymore
[*] Changed healing to a flat value of 15hp for human units, and 30hp for vehicles
[*] Reduced taking cover to 7 from 10 seconds
[*] Adjusted balancing on Omaha, Bocage, Carentan, and Airfield
[*] Buffed the MG unit: damage is now 3-5 base and 4-7 on upgrade from 2-4/3-5, AOE damage is now 1-2 from 1, range on upgrade is now 15 from 12 metres
[*] Buffed the Flamethrower unit: damage is now 3-5 from 2-4, DOT duration is 5 from 3 seconds
[*] Buffed the Leutnant unit: range is now 30 from 20 metres
[*] Nerfed the Combat Rifle unit: damage is now 4-5 and 5-7 on upgrade from 5/7, health is now 8 and 10hp on upgrade from 10/12hp
[/list]
[i]Special thanks to Supermauz_R for some good ideas![/i]

Please let me know should you find any other bugs.

Have a good one!

Cheers

Zuck

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.02
notes.content:
Soldiers!

This hotfix shall help with UI distortions when playing at ultrawide resolutions e.g., the continue button for the minimap tutorial was off-screen forcing players to lower resolution in order to end the tutorial. 

However, [b][i]please note that For The Fatherland was developed for common resolutions such as 1920x1080 & 2560x1440[/i][/b], thus UI distortions at alternative resolutions might indeed appear. I have not figured out yet how to fix that in a sustainable way…

[i]Special thanks to user 1 for reporting this issue![/i]

Cheers

Zuck

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.01
notes.content:
Hey lads,

I have fixed a bug that would not let you close the game menu on Omaha, Rekrut difficulty, once you opened it. I have checked all maps for said issue and could not find any further bugs, thus the game should work as intended now.

[i]Special thanks to 1stHeretic for reporting the bug![/i]

I apologize for the inconvenience, please let me know if any other issues occur.

Have a good one!

Zuck

notes.title: Full Release on Steam
notes.content:
Soldiers!

[b]It’s about time, I am proud to announce the full release of [i]For The Fatherland[/i]![/b]

As of today, [i]For The Fatherland[/i] is leaving the Early Access phase and the development process is coming to an end. I have implemented all of the content and community feedback you so kindly provided. Although the work on FTF is completed, I will provide hotfixes and patches should bugs or balancing issues occur. However, I would like to move on and start working on a new project building upon my experience gained while working on FTF.

[b]Full release patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow zooming in and out when you paused the game
[*] Reduced the depot price of the smoke grenade ability from 100/50 to 50/50
[*] Made some minor visual adjustments
[*] Resized the depot ability icons
[*] Implemented a more sophisticated six step tutorial on the first map
[*] Changed some graphics options which should reduce the stress put on the GPU, I hope this improves the performance
[*] Removed the percentage displayed on loading as it was causing issues (no idea why though)
[*] Implemented seven Steam achievements
[*] Updated the game trailer
[/list]
[i]Special thanks to Christiano for pointing out several issues![/i]


[b]Thank you for all of your feedback and support! I hope you enjoy the game…[/b]

Cheers and see you on [url=https://discord.gg/BVSjTvv][b]DISCORD![/b][/url]

Zuck

notes.title: All Quiet on the Eastern Front
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

Finally, the last map for FTF is now live!

This time you will have to face the many relentless Soviet forces attacking your base on [b]Kursk[/b], but fear not, new glorious weapons are waiting for you to use them, including the famous [i]Flak 88[/i]!

As always, you might need to replay Castle in order to unlock the last map.

[b]Patch 1.5 notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced prices of the Tiger I and StuG IV tanks
[*] Nurse is now slightly faster
[*] Fixed the sniper ability, aiming should work better now
[*] Adjusted few minor things
[/list]

[b]What now?[/b]

Although Kursk is the last map for FTF, I still wish to change and improve some things in the game, which I did not manage to do so far. I would also like to implement Steam Achievements, but no idea how this stuff works, so I will have to try it out first and see how it goes. 

The full release should happen soon, but should you have any feedback, I will try to implement it in a hot fix prior to ending the Early Access phase.

Take care and looking forward to your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/BVSjTvv][b]DISCORD![/b][/url]

Zuck

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Airfield
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers!

It is now roughly five weeks after the release of [i]Carentan [/i]and I think it is time for some new content, right? Right!

I’ve been working on the next map for FTF i.e., [b]Airfield [/b]which will *surprise – surprise* introduce air units into the game. I plan a total of four air units aka planes: two for the enemy, and two for you to use. In all probability, you will have one plane for air-to-air combat, and one plane for air-to-ground combat. Additionally, I will try to introduce an anti-air ground unit to provide more tactical freedom against enemy planes. Of course, you will be also able to use the currently available ground units, including tanks.

Finally, the work on map design is pretty much finished (I might make some adjustments though), so now I’ll move on to work on unit functionality and game logic. Please note, I’m super busy with university work, therefore the release of Airfield might indeed take some time :(

Anyways, I’ve something for you to look at down below! *cough* *cough*

notes.title: Carentan Release and More Updates!
notes.content:
[b]Achtung![/b]

Following your great dedication to the Fatherland on Omaha and Bocage a new challenge lies for you ahead: the Battle of Carentan!

The first major [i]For The Fatherland[/i] update introduces the third map of the German campaign [i]Carentan[/i], and indeed plenty of new content. In fact, Omaha beach went through a visual redesign, as the map lacked behind in quality compared to Bocage and especially to Carentan. The update also includes numerous minor fixes, small adjustments, and tweaks.

[b]General:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added three new music pieces to the music player rotation
[*] Fixed several issues with animation and sound synchronization
[*] Fixed a lighting bug which made weird shadows on the ground texture
[*] Adjusted player unit behaviour e.g., the bullet speed of the Combat Rifle unit has been increased
[*] Added three new player units: Tank Trap, StuG IV, Tiger I
[*] Added five new enemy units: Grenadier, Officer, Tank Driver, Haft-truck, Sherman
[*] Added three new abilities: Giftgas, Heal & Repair, Achtung! (Taking Cover)
[*] All player units can now take damage from some enemy units
[*] Increased time between waves from 5 seconds to 10 seconds
[*] Increased resources bonus after each wave from 15/15 to 25/25
[*] Adjusted the price of some units and abilities
[*] Deleted several artifacts and adjusted code to improve performance
[*] Enhanced post-processing to make the game look more pleasant
[*] Added the lock-on-sight mechanic (LOS) to the game i.e., units will only attack an enemy if they can actually see it, objects such as walls will block the view now (not entirely included on all maps!)
[*] Added a camera shaker to explosions, Omaha is now rather shaky *couch*
[*] Updated the Units window in the Main Menu
[*] Reduced the volume of the Machine Gun unit as the sound was [i]a little bit[/i] too annoying
[*] You can now play the next random music clip by pressing F3 (its random, so clips might repeat)
[*] And a bunch of other small changes
[/list]

[b]Omaha:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked the visual map design and added more detail
[*] Added one new enemy unit
[*] Added one new ability
[*] Adjusted the wave spawner difficulty to be more newbie-friendly
[*] The MG and Flamethrower units use lock on sight mechanics, due to the map design (trenches) the remaining units work as before
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938522/e674bf3940d491b9c8c0966d15e33de3c178aa5d.jpg[/img]


[b]Bocage:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small adjustments to post-processing
[*] Added two new enemy units
[*] Added two new abilities
[*] The Smoke Grenade ability is now unlocked from the very beginning to give players more options and because forcing the players to buy the same abilities each map didn’t seem fair (you will get a small bonus after each map from now on)
[*] Adjusted the wave spawner
[*] LOS not activated on Bocage as not really needed here due to the open map design (LOS consumes more processing power)
[*] Lowered the difficulty level as it was a little bit too harsh
[*] Fixed a bug which resulted in the deduction of three player lives after a Jeep unit reached its target, its one life now
[/list]

[b]Carentan:[/b]
[list]
[*] The map can be unlocked after playing and winning Bocage! Sorry for the inconvenience, but we are in Early Access after all 😊
[/list]

As always, please consider joining my [url=https://discord.gg/BVSjTvv][b]DISCORD[/b][/url] in order to provide feedback on FTF and more...

Finally, please find below three [i]For The Fatherland[/i] wallpapers in the new look!

Take care and stay safe

Zuck

PS. The next map might take a while, since I’m not entirely sure what I will go for, but probably it will be a larger tank battle, maybe even including air units aka planes… stay tuned!

notes.title: New Map: Carentan - First Look
notes.content:
Hey Lads!

Today I would like to share with you some insights on the upcoming third map: [b]Carentan[/b].

Carentan is one of those iconic maps you can find in pretty much every WW2 video game such as in the classic [i]Call of Duty 1 & 2[/i], and quite recently in [i]Hell Let Loose[/i]. Should you also have watched the [i]Band of Brothers[/i] TV series you will probably remember that epic assault of the Easy Company, and ehm Winters getting shot in his butt (or was it his leg?). By the way, my favorite part has always been camping behind the MG near gallery and suddenly popping up to yeet down approaching players, easy kill, easy life :P

Anyways, the initial map design is finished so far, I’ll continue adding more details and further work on effects & post processing, but all the major stuff is done. The “work” shifts now to the implementation of new abilities and units with the [b]Tiger I[/b] (PzKpfw VI) and the [b]M4 Sherman[/b] as highlights with the most powerful bang!

Below more information on Carentan and something to look at :D

Featured on Carentan as of now:

[list]
[*] 2 map events
[*] 5 new units (2 enemy, 3 player)
[*] 2 new player abilities
[*] Reworked unit mechanics #1: units use now the [i]shoot on sight[/i] mechanic to better simulate urban combat → no shooting through objects anymore! 
[*] Reworked unit mechanics #2: some player units can be attacked and destroyed, could expand to all player units if this is something you guys want
[*] A basket full of easter eggs!
[/list]

Take care and enjoy the summer!

Zuck

notes.title: For The Fatherland releases in Early Access!
notes.content:
[b]Kommandant![/b]

Today at 6:30 a.m. Berlin time a large-scale Allied landing operation in Normandy has begun, our sectors along the northern French coast are under heavy enemy fire, our reign over France is in danger! Kommandant, you have been ordered to defeat the enemy and bring glory to the fatherland. 

[b]For The Fatherland![/b]

I’m very pleased to announce the Early Access release of [i]For The Fatherland[/i], a tower defense strategy game taking place during the Second World War in which you are in charge of German troops in an attempt to defend strategic position from the Allied invasion.

Given that balancing and bug fixing is indeed a delicate issue, I would like to invite everyone to my [url=https://discord.gg/BVSjTvv][b]Discord Server[/b][/url] in order to help with the development of FTF, especially the balancing part of the game. As [i]For The Fatherland[/i] is a game in development, any suggestions on new units, abilities, and map designs are truly welcome, I’ll try to implement as many as possible into the final version of the game.

Please note, [i]For The Fatherland[/i] is meant to be challenging à la the good old Warcraft 3:TFT tower defense mods, don’t give up if you fail at the first time. You can definitely beat the game with few tricks!

[b]So, what is actually planned for the future?[/b]

I’m aiming at a total of five maps, each in a unique setting and with a slightly different combat focus. The next map, after the currently playable Omaha Beach and Bocage Village, will be the iconic Carentan on which I plan to implement urban combat mechanics, more scripted events, and glorious tanks!

I hope you will enjoy playing [i]For The Fatherland[/i] and please feel free to say hello on Discord.

Cheers

Zuck
